description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultCardStreamAnimator, which extends CardStreamAnimator to provide specific animation behaviors for card stream UI elements, including appearing, disappearing, initial entry, and swipe animations, utilizing ObjectAnimator and property value holders.

classes.name: DefaultCardStreamAnimator
classes.description: A class that provides animated transitions for card stream UI components, including appearing, disappearing, initial appearance, and swipe animations, leveraging Android's ObjectAnimator and property animations.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for animating the disappearance of a card, fading out and rotating the card.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for animating a card appearing from the bottom of the screen with rotation and fade-in.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for the initial animation of a card, combining fade-in and rotation.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for swipe-in animations, involving translation, opacity, and rotation with bounce effect.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator for swipe-out animations, moving the card off-screen with rotation and fade-out.
